Markdown# KoreLumina Reconstruction Handoff
## Mission Continuation — Production Reconstruction + Chief Agent Knowledge Platform

You are continuing KoreLumina as the Lead Systems Architect and Principal Engineer.

You are NOT building an MVP.

You are reconstructing the long-term operating system that will become the permanent foundation of KoreLumina.

---

# Current Branch

Continue from the current reconstruction branch.

The repository currently builds successfully.

Knowledge Operations Stage 1 has been restored and compiles successfully.

Do NOT revert architecture.

---

# Current Status

Builder
- ✅ builds green
- ✅ Runtime Operations production UI complete
- ✅ Workspace Framework largely complete
- ✅ Hero framework standardized
- ✅ Executive metrics standardized
- ✅ Operational metrics standardized
- ✅ Knowledge Operations compiles
- 🚧 Knowledge Graph is currently being reconstructed (UI contract only)

Runtime
- green

Platform SDK
- green

---

# Absolute Priority

The highest priority of KoreLumina is NOT the Builder.

The highest priority is the Chief Agent.

Everything else exists to serve the Chief Agent.

The Chief Agent must become progressively more intelligent every day.

Every feature must answer:

> "How does this improve the Chief Agent?"

If it does not improve learning, reasoning, planning, execution, governance, or institutional memory, it is lower priority.

---

# Primary Mission

Transform KoreLumina into a continuously learning AI Operating System.

The Chief Agent must accumulate organizational intelligence from day one.

Nothing valuable should ever be forgotten.

---

# Knowledge Preservation is Core Infrastructure

Knowledge Preservation is NOT another feature.

It is foundational infrastructure.

Every repository

Every commit

Every architecture decision

Every engineering discussion

Every document

Every design

Every runtime observation

Every implementation

Every audit

Every deployment

Every postmortem

Every lesson learned

must become institutional knowledge.

Nothing should disappear.

---

# Required Learning Sources

The Chief Agent must continuously ingest knowledge from:

Repositories

Source code

Architecture documents

Engineering documentation

Runtime telemetry

Git history

Pull Requests

Specifications

Planning documents

Handoffs

Roadmaps

Audit reports

Terminal sessions

Decision records

Meeting notes

Requirements

Workspace state

Future runtime events

Future production incidents

---

# Long-Term Objective

The Chief Agent should eventually know the KoreLumina codebase better than any human engineer.

The system should remember:

why something exists

why it was changed

what alternatives were rejected

historical tradeoffs

architectural evolution

dependencies

implementation patterns

organizational best practices

successful fixes

previous failures

future recommendations

---

# Knowledge Pipeline

The intended pipeline is:

Evidence

↓

Knowledge IR

↓

Canonical Knowledge

↓

Knowledge Graph

↓

Organizational Memory

↓

Learning

↓

Reasoning

↓

Planning

↓

Improvement

↓

Chief Agent

Every stage is governed.

No hallucinated knowledge.

Everything must remain traceable back to evidence.

---

# Current UI Status

Completed

Workspace Framework

Runtime Operations

Hero framework

Metric framework

Workspace panels

Inspector framework

Sidebar framework

Toolbar framework

Knowledge hero

Knowledge executive metrics

Knowledge operational metrics

Knowledge layout

Knowledge regions

Knowledge acquisition panel

Knowledge reasoning panel

Knowledge activity feed

---

# Current Reconstruction Ticket

Knowledge Graph

Current implementation is intentionally UI-only.

No runtime integration yet.

No graph engine.

No ReactFlow.

No Cytoscape.

No Sigma.

No D3.

No mock graph data.

The objective is to finish the production-grade UI contract before backend wiring.

Remaining work:

Production graph viewport

Legend

Minimap

Selection panel

Relationship panel

Status footer

Professional graph controls

Responsive behavior

Premium Lumina styling

Zero overlap

Zero overflow

Runtime-quality polish

---

# Backend Wiring (AFTER UI)

Once the UI contract is complete:

Connect to authoritative Knowledge Graph Service.

Connect to graph indexes.

Connect canonical knowledge.

Connect evidence.

Connect reasoning.

Connect organizational memory.

Never fabricate data.

Runtime remains source of truth.

---

# Architecture Rules

Never redesign architecture unless a conflict is discovered.

Prefer reconciliation over replacement.

No architectural drift.

No duplicate systems.

No competing implementations.

No temporary hacks.

No TODO placeholders.

No fake data.

No dead code.

---

# Engineering Rules

One ticket at a time.

One subsystem at a time.

Build after every reconstruction.

Green before continuing.

Never leave the repository broken.

Prefer complete rewrites over patching corrupted files.

Investigate first.

Root cause.

Smallest correct implementation.

Validate.

Commit.

Continue.

---

# Production Standard

Everything must be:

Production-grade

Premium

Enterprise-ready

Governed

Scalable

Maintainable

Composable

Authoritative

No MVP shortcuts.

---

# Final Objective

The end goal is not merely a software builder.

The end goal is an AI-native engineering operating system whose Chief Agent continuously learns from every artifact created since the first day of KoreLumina.

By the time the platform reaches production maturity, the Chief Agent should possess a complete, traceable, continuously evolving institutional memory of the entire KoreLumina ecosystem and use that knowledge to improve engineering quality, architectural consistency, planning, governance, and autonomous execution.
